formattedAddress: No. 8號, Lane 107, Jiangnan St, Gangqian Village, Neihu District, Taipei City, Taiwan 114

text.text:
Gloriosa Pizza, tucked away in the alleys of Jiangnan Street in Neihu District, offers a variety of creative pizzas and pasta flavors. The key is the carefully selected ingredients and the perfectly recreated, chewy crust (higher moisture content prevents it from hardening) characteristic of pizzas from central and northern Taiwan – clearly a result of careful planning and investment. Their Apricot Duck Breast Pizza, Smoked Salmon with Capers, and Sun-Shaped Pizza are extremely popular; the Spicy Pink Shrimp Pasta, Stir-Fried Cucumber and Chicken, White Wine Clams, and Mixed Cheese White Sauce are all delicious. Yesterday, I had four slices left over (different flavors) to take home and eat again tonight – trying it without baking, and it was just as good! The shop has no advertising or flashy decorations, but it's bright, warm, and comfortable. The young owners are friendly and welcoming, and the prices are reasonable, no wonder it's become a favorite among employees in the Neihu Science Park. Highly recommended!!

PS. The drink selection is limited, but the owner said they'll improve it. For larger groups, they can also customize certain tapas – very thoughtful.

originalText.text:
內湖區江南街巷弄裏的“Gloriosa Pizza~葛莉莎披薩”,有著各類創意的匹薩及意大利麵口味. 重點是: 匹薩的食材選取+極度還原中北部義式較韌勁的口感麵皮(濕度較高所以不易硬化),絕對是花了心思和成本的.杏桃鴨胸匹薩.燻鮭魚酸豆.太陽.都有極高的人氣；辣味粉紅蝦麵.清炒櫛瓜雞肉.白酒蛤蜊和綜合起司白醬,都好吃.昨天剩了4片(不同口味的匹薩)帶回家晚上再吃~試試不烘烤,竟一樣好吃耶.
小店沒有廣告,沒有超吸睛的裝璜,但明亮.溫馨.舒服,年軽的老闆夫妻服務親切又熱情,還有合理的價格,難怪成爲內湖科技園區內员工的新寵.很值得推薦!!
PS.飲品選項較少,老闆說再改進,若人數多,還可訂製一些特定Tapas,很有誠意.

text.text:
This pizzeria was better than I expected overall.

We ordered a pesto chicken pizza. The crust was thin and crispy with slightly charred edges. The pesto flavor wasn't too strong, and it paired perfectly with the chicken and zucchini. The overall taste was refreshing and not greasy.

We also ordered a seafood pasta. The sauce was flavorful, and the pasta was cooked to the perfect firmness.

Overall, the environment was comfortable, and the food quality was consistently good. It's the kind of place I'd visit again.

If you happen to be in the area, it's a place you can confidently dine at.

originalText.text:
來到這家披薩店，整體表現比想像中好。

我們點了一份青醬雞肉披薩，餅皮薄脆、邊緣帶一點焦香，青醬味道不會太重，搭配雞肉和櫛瓜剛好，口味偏清爽不膩。
另一份是海鮮義大利麵，醬汁味道夠，麵條硬度也控制得不錯。

整體來說環境舒適、餐點水準穩定，屬於那種可以再訪的類型。
如果剛好在附近，算是一間可以安心走進去用餐的店。
